column9: Analyst: Connor Haddad Rating: REDUCE 12-month target price: USD 61.16 Share price (close, 13 March 2026): USD 67.36 Implied upside: -9.2% Investment summary Kestrel Semiconductor Ltd. reported FY2025 revenue of USD 2,409.4 million (+10.7% year on year) and operating income of USD 695.0 million. Management guided to revenue growth of approximately 9% for FY2026. We reiterate our REDUCE rating with a target price of USD 61.16. We see downside risk to consensus estimates as growth slows, and the shares trade at a premium to peers. Key takeaways Operating margin of 28.8% in FY2025, versus 27.9% in FY2024. Automotive Chips and Data Center remain the core of the investment case. Balance sheet remains conservative; capital returns are increasing. Estimate changes We raise our FY2026E revenue estimate to USD 2,617.5 million from USD 2,555.1 million, and our FY2026E diluted EPS estimate to USD 5.13."
